title: MM-CRITIC: A Holistic Evaluation of Large Multimodal Models as Multimodal Critique

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the correlation between the text length of the generated critiques and the scores assigned by the judge model to determine if the judge disproportionately favors longer responses.

Evaluating the generated critiques using different judge models (e.g., GPT-4.1 vs. Claude-4.0-sonnet) and reference critiques from various models to assess if judges exhibit a preference for specific model styles or families.
